note: The CLI accepts sdkMcpServers only as an array of strings. Any object or array-of-objects fails the ENTIRE initialize, which silently disables hooks, agents, system prompt and output format. Naming servers here is also wrong for this SDK: it marks them SDK-hosted, so the CLI drops their transports and routes tool calls over mcp_message control_requests, which this SDK does not implement — measured live, the server's tools vanish from the session. Hence the key is never sent. See issue #38.
